authorship: FermatMind Editorial / 费马测试编辑部; independently authored bilingual scenarios and interpretation; not an IPRS translation or competitor adaptation

prompt.en: A small change to a plan left me unsettled through the next ordinary activity.
prompt.zh: 计划出现小变动后，接下来的日常活动中我仍心绪不定。

prompt.en: After an inconvenient delay, I needed so much time to settle that I abandoned what I had planned next.
prompt.zh: 遇到不方便的延误后，我花了很久才平复，以至于放弃了下一件原定要做的事。

prompt.en: When several minor demands arrived together, I became too overwhelmed to choose one manageable response.
prompt.zh: 几件小事同时需要处理时，我被情绪淹没，难以选出一个能应付的做法。

prompt.en: I carried the agitation from an earlier setback into an unrelated conversation.
prompt.zh: 我把之前受挫时的烦躁带进了一场不相关的谈话。

prompt.en: A minor frustration kept pulling my attention back even after the immediate problem was resolved.
prompt.zh: 一个小挫折已经解决后，我的注意力仍被当时的不快反复拉回。

prompt.en: After receiving a small correction, I treated it privately as evidence that I was inadequate in many areas.
prompt.zh: 收到一个小小的纠正后，我私下把它当成自己在很多方面都不够好的证据。

prompt.en: While reviewing an ordinary day, I dismissed what had gone adequately and dwelt on what I disliked about myself.
prompt.zh: 回顾普通的一天时，我忽略了做得还可以的部分，反复想着自己令自己不满意的地方。

prompt.en: In a routine choice that was mine to make, doubt about my own judgment kept me from choosing.
prompt.zh: 面对一件由我自己作主的日常小事，我因怀疑自己的判断而迟迟选不下来。

prompt.en: A disappointing moment became a harsh private story about who I am, rather than about that one event.
prompt.zh: 一次失望的经历变成了我对自己整个人的苛刻评价，而不只是对那件事的看法。

prompt.en: I withdrew from an ordinary activity because I felt discouraged about myself, even though participation was available.
prompt.zh: 虽然有机会参加一项日常活动，我还是因为对自己感到灰心而退了出来。

prompt.en: I set aside time for something I wanted to move forward, but finished the time slot without choosing a concrete next step.
prompt.zh: 我为一件自己想推进的事留出了时间，却到时间结束还没有选出具体下一步。

prompt.en: During a short task I had chosen, I repeatedly opened unrelated material and lost the thread of what I was doing.
prompt.zh: 做一件自己选定的短任务时，我反复打开不相关的内容，忘了原本做到哪里。

prompt.en: When two small personal priorities competed, I kept switching between them without advancing either.
prompt.zh: 两件自己的小事同时需要安排时，我来回切换，却两件都没有推进。

prompt.en: After a brief interruption, I did not return to the step I had intended to finish despite having time left.
prompt.zh: 短暂被打断后，虽然还有时间，我也没有回到本来打算做完的那一步。

prompt.en: I agreed with a personal plan in principle but let its next action remain vague when it was time to act.
prompt.zh: 我原则上认同自己的某个计划，但到了该行动时，仍把下一步停留在模糊的说法里。

prompt.en: In a shared activity, I took a shortcut that ignored an agreed rule and left someone else to handle the consequence.
prompt.zh: 共同活动中，我为了省事绕过约定的规则，把后果留给别人处理。

prompt.en: I sent or posted a response before checking its likely effect on the people involved.
prompt.zh: 发出消息或发布回应前，我没有先想它可能给相关的人带来什么影响。

prompt.en: For a small immediate benefit, I used a shared resource in a way that went beyond the permission I had.
prompt.zh: 为了眼前一点方便，我使用共同资源时超出了自己已有的许可。

prompt.en: I made a quick commitment involving another person before checking whether I could keep it.
prompt.zh: 涉及别人时，我还没有确认自己能否做到，就很快作出了承诺。

prompt.en: When a routine limit frustrated me, I pushed past it rather than checking a permitted alternative.
prompt.zh: 一项日常限制让我不耐烦时，我直接越过了它，没有先找符合约定的替代办法。

prompt.en: I continued polishing an ordinary piece of work after it already met the purpose we had agreed on.
prompt.zh: 一件普通的工作已经达到事先约定的用途后，我仍继续打磨细节。

prompt.en: A harmless change in how a shared task was done bothered me enough to delay progress.
prompt.zh: 共同任务的做法有一个无害的小变化，我为此纠结到耽误了进度。

prompt.en: I repeated a routine check without finding new information, while another planned activity waited.
prompt.zh: 没有出现新信息时，我仍重复一项例行检查，让另一件原定要做的事一直等着。

prompt.en: I avoided showing a usable first attempt because it did not match the exact standard in my head.
prompt.zh: 第一版已经能用，我却因为它不符合自己脑中的精确标准而不愿拿出来。

prompt.en: I used more time than the situation required to keep a minor detail exactly as I preferred.
prompt.zh: 为了让一个小细节完全符合自己的偏好，我花了超出情境实际需要的时间。

prompt.en: While I had a concrete action available, I spent the time imagining how the finished outcome would look instead.
prompt.zh: 明明有具体一步可以做，我却把时间花在想象完成后的样子上。

prompt.en: I mentally replayed an imagined version of a conversation until I missed part of the real conversation or activity around me.
prompt.zh: 我在脑中反复演着一段设想的谈话，以至于漏掉了身边真实谈话或活动的一部分。

prompt.en: I elaborated a possible future so far that I lost track of the small decision actually in front of me.
prompt.zh: 我把一种可能的未来想得越来越细，反而忘了眼前真正要作的小决定。

prompt.en: During time meant for an ordinary activity, I remained absorbed in an invented story and left the activity unfinished.
prompt.zh: 本来留给一项日常活动的时间里，我一直沉浸在自己编想的故事中，让活动没有完成。

prompt.en: After noticing that I was mentally elsewhere, I returned to the imagined scene rather than the practical step I had selected.
prompt.zh: 发现自己神游后，我又回到想象中的情节，没有回到已经选好的实际一步。

prompt.en: When I had a little free time, none of the available activities felt worth engaging with.
prompt.zh: 有一点空闲时，眼前可选的活动都让我觉得提不起投入的意愿。

prompt.en: I joined an activity I usually choose freely but felt little personal interest while taking part.
prompt.zh: 我参加了一项平时会主动选择的活动，但参与时很少感到自己的兴趣。

prompt.en: An invitation that normally fits my interests felt flat to me, even after practical obstacles were removed.
prompt.zh: 一个通常符合我兴趣的邀请，在实际障碍已经排除后，仍让我觉得索然无味。

prompt.en: I let an enjoyable possibility pass because I felt little pull toward it, rather than because I could not organize the steps.
prompt.zh: 一个可能有趣的机会过去了，我没有行动，主要是因为没有兴趣牵引，而不是不会安排步骤。

prompt.en: At the end of a chosen leisure activity, I noticed that I had gone through it with very little feeling of involvement.
prompt.zh: 完成一项自己选择的休闲活动后，我发现自己只是走完了过程，很少有参与其中的感觉。

label.en: Not applicable / prefer not to answer

method.unit: unweighted arithmetic mean of five ordinal frequency responses; descriptive website summary only
method.formula: round((sum of the five numeric values / 5) * 10) / 10
method.numericValidity: only integer numbers 1..5; no strings, booleans, null, inherited entries, NaN, Infinity, decimals or extra keys accepted as numeric answers
method.finish: exact 35 known item keys, each with integer1..5 or literal na
method.perDomainMissing: any na in a domain withholds only that domain mean; show numeric count/5; never impute or treat na as1/0
method.incomplete: unanswered/invalid item cannot finish; do not silently convert to na
method.allNa: all35 na is a finished unscored report with all seven complete guides
method.reportOrder: fixed original seven-topic order; never sort by score

workedExample.meaning: arithmetic illustration only; not a medium category

method.adoptionBoundary: This is an original website method; neither the original IPRS96 nor the IDR-HYBT35 algorithm.

publicIdentityNote.en: These 35 everyday scenarios and their seven descriptive averages were written for FermatMind. Research on intrapersonal problems informed the topic map only. This check-in is not the Intrapersonal Problems Rating Scales (IPRS), has no established norms or screening cutoffs, and has not inherited the research instrument’s validation. The imagined-scenarios topic deliberately covers everyday mental absorption only; it does not cover the full research domain of Fantasy Proneness or assess unusual perceptual experiences.
publicIdentityNote.zh: 这35个日常情境与七项描述性均分由费马原创。个人内在困难研究只用于厘清主题地图。本观察不是个人内在问题评定量表（IPRS），没有已建立的常模或筛查阈值，也不继承研究量表的验证。“想象占用当下”有意仅涉及日常神游与想象投入，不覆盖研究中Fantasy Proneness的完整范围，也不评估异常感知体验。

researchCitation: Boudreaux, M. J., Lengel, G. J., Oltmanns, T. F., & Ozer, D. J. (2021). Assessment of self-related problems in functioning: Intrapersonal Problems Rating Scales. Psychological Assessment, 33(6), 526–540.
researchUse: topic map only; not the IPRS questionnaire, key or validation
editorialApplication: Root supplied seven unique titles/headlines and short SEO descriptions; frozen paragraphs and method unchanged
